description: This Java class 'KeyStoreUtil' provides utility methods for handling keystores and certificates, including loading, storing, converting, and parsing certificates and keystore entries within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: KeyStoreUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing keystores and certificates, including loading, storing, converting, and parsing certificates within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: storeComponentKeyStore
methods.description: Stores a keystore for a specific component and keystore name to a file.

methods.name: getComponentKeyStore
methods.description: Retrieves a keystore for a specific component and keystore name.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Loads a keystore from a URL with specified password and type.

methods.name: getSystemTrustStore
methods.description: Loads the system trust store, defaulting to Java's default trust store files.

methods.name: readCertificate
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a byte array.

methods.name: getCertX500Map
methods.description: Returns a map of the subject's X500 principal distinguished name components.

methods.name: getX500Map
methods.description: Parses an X500 Principal into a map of its components.

methods.name: importPKCS8CertChain
methods.description: Imports a private key and certificate chain into a keystore under a specified alias.

methods.name: certToString
methods.description: Converts a Certificate object to a PEM-formatted string.

methods.name: pemToCert
methods.description: Parses a PEM-formatted certificate string, file, or input stream into a Certificate object.

methods.name: pemToPkHex
methods.description: Extracts the public key from a PEM certificate and returns it as a hex string.
